tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_alliance_level_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_metric_alliance_level value = 0 }
	save_scope_as = tv_victory_task_metric_owner
	every_international_organizations_member_of = {
		limit = { international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_diplomatic_alliance }
		if = { limit = { var:tv_alliance_tier > scope:tv_victory_task_metric_owner.var:tv_victory_task_metric_alliance_level } scope:tv_victory_task_metric_owner = { set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_metric_alliance_level value = prev.var:tv_alliance_tier } } }
	}
}

tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_average_development_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_metric_average_development value = 0 }
	save_scope_as = tv_victory_task_metric_owner
	every_owned_location = {
		scope:tv_victory_task_metric_owner = { change_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_metric_average_development add = prev.development } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { num_locations > 0 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_metric_average_development divide = num_locations }
	}
}

tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_conquest_slot_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_1003_claimed_index ?= { this >= 10 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_colonial_locations_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_1002_claimed_index ?= { this >= 10 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_owned_locations_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_1001_claimed_index ?= { this >= 10 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_total_locations_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared value = 1 }
		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_conquest_slot_1_effect = yes
		remove_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared
	}
}

tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_all_conquest_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled }
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_target
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_target_index
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_progress_pct
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_complete
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_culture_group
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_target_index value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_2_target
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_2_target_index
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_2_progress_pct
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_2_complete
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_2_culture_group
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_2_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_2_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_2_target_index value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_2_progress_pct value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_3_target
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_3_target_index
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_3_progress_pct
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_3_complete
		remove_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_3_culture_group
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_3_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_3_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_3_target_index value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_task_slot_3_progress_pct value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_1003_claimed_index ?= { this >= 10 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_colonial_locations_effect = yes
		}

				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_1002_claimed_index ?= { this >= 10 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_owned_locations_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_1001_claimed_index ?= { this >= 10 } }

		}

	}

tv_victory_path_tasks_claim_conquest_slot_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_human = yes
			has_variable = tv_conquest_task_slot_1_complete
			var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_id ?= { this > 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = tv_conquest_tree_points add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_id ?= 1001 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_1001_claimed_index value = var:tv_conquest_task_slot_1_target_index }
		}

				trigger = {
					tv_victory_task_2104_candidate = yes
					NOT = { var:tv_prosperity_task_slot_1_id ?= 2104 }
					NOT = { var:tv_prosperity_task_slot_2_id ?= 2104 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_task_slot_3_id value = 2104 }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = {
					tv_victory_task_2105_candidate = yes
					NOT = { var:tv_prosperity_task_slot_1_id ?= 2105 }
					NOT = { var:tv_prosperity_task_slot_2_id ?= 2105 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_prosperity_task_slot_3_id value = 2105 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_prosperity_task_slot_3_id ?= { this > 0 } }
		tv_victory_path_tasks_update_prosperity_slot_3_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_victory_path_tasks_update_trade_slot_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_trade_task_slot_1_complete }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3001 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared } }
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_trade_income_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = var:tv_victory_task_metric_trade_income }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct divide = var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_target }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct multiply = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct < 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct > 100 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_victory_task_metric_trade_income ?= { this >= var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_target } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_complete value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3002 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared } }
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_dominant_markets_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = var:tv_victory_task_metric_dominant_markets }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct divide = var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_target }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct multiply = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct < 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct > 100 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_victory_task_metric_dominant_markets ?= { this >= var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_target } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_complete value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3101 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3102 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3103 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3104 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
	}

				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_3002_claimed_index ?= { this >= 18 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_dominant_markets_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_3001_claimed_index ?= { this >= 9 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_trade_income_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared value = 1 }
		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_trade_slot_1_effect = yes
		remove_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_2_target value = 0 }

		remove_variable = tv_trade_task_slot_3_complete

		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_task_slot_3_id value = 0 }

tv_victory_path_tasks_claim_trade_slot_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_human = yes
			has_variable = tv_trade_task_slot_1_complete
			var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= { this > 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_tree_points add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3001 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_3001_claimed_index value = var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_target_index }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3002 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_3002_claimed_index value = var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_target_index }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3101 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_3101_claimed value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_task_slot_1_id ?= 3102 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_task_slot_1_id ?= 4001 }

			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared } }
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_diplomatic_reputation_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = var:tv_victory_task_metric_diplomatic_reputation }
		change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_task_slot_1_progress_pct divide = var:tv_diplomatic_task_slot_1_target }

tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_diplomatic_slot_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_enabled }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_4002_claimed_index ?= { this >= 15 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_alliance_level_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_4001_claimed_index ?= { this >= 19 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_diplomatic_reputation_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_victory_task_4101_claimed }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_num_allies_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared value = 1 }
		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_diplomatic_slot_1_effect = yes
		remove_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared
	}
}

				NOT = { has_variable = tv_victory_task_4101_claimed }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_num_allies_effect = yes

		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_diplomatic_slot_1_effect = yes
		if = {

				NOT = { var:tv_diplomatic_task_slot_1_id ?= 0 }
			}
			tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_diplomatic_slot_2_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_diplomatic_task_slot_1_id ?= 0 }
				NOT = { var:tv_diplomatic_task_slot_2_id ?= 0 }

			tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_diplomatic_slot_3_effect = yes
		}
		remove_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared

tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_cultural_slot_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes has_variable = tv_cultural_victory_enabled }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_5001_claimed_index ?= { this >= 20 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_artworks_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_5002_claimed_index ?= { this >= 6 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_best_art_quality_pct_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_5003_claimed_index ?= { this >= 5 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_best_artist_skill_pct_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_5005_claimed_index ?= { this >= 10 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_cultural_influence_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_5004_claimed_index ?= { this >= 10 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_cultural_tradition_effect = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_5006_claimed_index ?= { this >= 10 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_exhibition_influence_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared value = 1 }
		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_cultural_slot_1_effect = yes
		remove_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared
	}
}

tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_all_cultural_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes has_variable = tv_cultural_victory_enabled }
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_1_target
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_1_target_index
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_1_progress_pct
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_1_complete
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_1_culture_group
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_1_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_1_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_1_target_index value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_2_target
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_2_target_index
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_2_progress_pct
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_2_complete
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_2_culture_group
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_2_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_2_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_2_target_index value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_2_progress_pct value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_3_target
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_3_target_index
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_3_progress_pct
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_3_complete
		remove_variable = tv_cultural_task_slot_3_culture_group
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_3_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_3_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_3_target_index value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_task_slot_3_progress_pct value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_5001_claimed_index ?= { this >= 20 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_artworks_effect = yes
		}
		if = {

		}

tv_victory_path_tasks_update_science_slot_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_complete }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 6102 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:black_death } }
			if = { limit = { tv_victory_task_6102_current_condition = yes } set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_complete value = 1 } set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 } }
			else = { tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_science_slot_1_effect = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 6001 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared } }
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_science_score_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = var:tv_victory_task_metric_science_score }
		change_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct divide = var:tv_science_task_slot_1_target }
		change_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct multiply = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct < 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct > 100 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_victory_task_metric_science_score ?= { this >= var:tv_science_task_slot_1_target } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_complete value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 6011 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_victory_task_6011_current_condition = yes }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_complete value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 6012 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_victory_task_6012_current_condition = yes }

			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_complete value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 6014 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_victory_task_6014_current_condition = yes }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_complete value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 100 }

	}
	else_if = {

tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_science_slot_1_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_target
	remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_target_index
	remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct
	remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_complete
	remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_culture_group
	set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_id value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_target value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_target_index value = 0 }

tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_science_slot_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes has_variable = tv_science_victory_enabled }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_6001_claimed_index ?= { this >= 9 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_science_score_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared value = 1 }
		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_science_slot_1_effect = yes
		remove_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared
	}
}

tv_victory_path_tasks_refill_empty_science_slots_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_6001_claimed_index ?= { this >= 9 } }
		}
		tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_science_score_effect = yes
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 0
		}
		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_science_slot_1_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_science_task_slot_2_id ?= 0
			NOT = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 0 }
		}
		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_science_slot_2_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_science_task_slot_3_id ?= 0
			NOT = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 0 }
			NOT = { var:tv_science_task_slot_2_id ?= 0 }
		}
		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_science_slot_3_effect = yes
	}
	remove_variable = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared
}

tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_all_science_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes has_variable = tv_science_victory_enabled }
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_target
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_target_index
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_complete
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_culture_group
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_target_index value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_1_progress_pct value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_2_target
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_2_target_index
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_2_progress_pct
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_2_complete
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_2_culture_group
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_2_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_2_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_2_target_index value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_2_progress_pct value = 0 }
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_3_target
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_3_target_index
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_3_progress_pct
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_3_complete
		remove_variable = tv_science_task_slot_3_culture_group
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_3_id value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_3_target value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_3_target_index value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_task_slot_3_progress_pct value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { var:tv_victory_task_6001_claimed_index ?= { this >= 9 } }
			}
			tv_victory_task_refresh_metric_science_score_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_candidate_metrics_prepared value = 1 }
		tv_victory_path_tasks_assign_science_slot_1_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {

	}

tv_victory_path_tasks_initialize_science_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes }
		set_variable = { name = tv_science_tree_points value = 0 }
		tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_all_science_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_victory_path_tasks_claim_science_slot_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_human = yes
			has_variable = tv_science_task_slot_1_complete
			var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= { this > 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = tv_science_tree_points add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 6001 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_6001_claimed_index value = var:tv_science_task_slot_1_target_index }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 6011 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_6011_claimed value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 6012 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_6012_claimed value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_science_task_slot_1_id ?= 6013 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_victory_task_6013_claimed value = 1 }
		}

	tv_victory_task_mark_5103_complete_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { var:tv_local_exhibition_last_rating ?= { this >= 2 } } tv_victory_task_mark_5104_complete_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { var:tv_local_exhibition_last_rating ?= { this >= 3 } } tv_victory_task_mark_5105_complete_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { var:tv_local_exhibition_last_rating ?= { this >= 4 } } tv_victory_task_mark_5106_complete_effect = yes }
}

tv_victory_task_join_war_callback_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { is_rival_of = root is_at_war_with = root } }
		tv_victory_task_mark_4103_complete_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_victory_task_italian_wars_ended_callback_effect = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_human = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:italian_league_1
						international_organization:italian_league_1 ?= { total_locations_owned >= 200 }
					}
					AND = {
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:italian_league_2
						international_organization:italian_league_2 ?= { total_locations_owned >= 200 }
					}
					AND = {
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:italian_league_3
						international_organization:italian_league_3 ?= { total_locations_owned >= 200 }
					}
					AND = {
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:foreign_league_balkan
						international_organization:foreign_league_balkan ?= { total_locations_owned >= 200 }
					}
					AND = {
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:foreign_league_france
						international_organization:foreign_league_france ?= { total_locations_owned >= 200 }
					}
					AND = {
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:foreign_league_hre
						international_organization:foreign_league_hre ?= { total_locations_owned >= 200 }
					}
					AND = {
						is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:foreign_league_iberia
						international_organization:foreign_league_iberia ?= { total_locations_owned >= 200 }
					}
				}
			}
			tv_victory_task_mark_4105_complete_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_task_slot_1_id ?= 4105 } tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_diplomatic_slot_1_effect = yes }
			if = { limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_task_slot_2_id ?= 4105 } tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_diplomatic_slot_2_effect = yes }
			if = { limit = { var:tv_diplomatic_task_slot_3_id ?= 4105 } tv_victory_path_tasks_refresh_diplomatic_slot_3_effect = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Same-ID vanilla helper override: append task resolution before league destruction.
REPLACE:destroy_all_italian_leagues = {
	tv_victory_task_italian_wars_ended_callback_effect = yes
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = destroy_all_italian_leagues_tt
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				capital.region = region:italy_region
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = international_organization:foreign_league_france }
				destroy_international_organization = { target = international_organization:foreign_league_france }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = international_organization:foreign_league_iberia }
				destroy_international_organization = { target = international_organization:foreign_league_iberia }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = international_organization:foreign_league_hre }
				destroy_international_organization = { target = international_organization:foreign_league_hre }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = international_organization:italian_league_1 }
				destroy_international_organization = { target = international_organization:italian_league_1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = international_organization:italian_league_2 }
				destroy_international_organization = { target = international_organization:italian_league_2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = international_organization:italian_league_3 }
				destroy_international_organization = { target = international_organization:italian_league_3 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = international_organization:foreign_league_balkan }
				destroy_international_organization = { target = international_organization:foreign_league_balkan }
			}
		}
	}
}
